jobs_results.description:
Introduction

Launch your career like an IBMer

Every IBMer has a story. For many, it started with an internship.

As an IBM co-op, you won't just gain experience - you'll start thinking, working, and growing like an IBMer. From day one, you'll contribute to real client projects across diverse industries, working alongside experienced IBMers who are invested in your success. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired, often all in the same day. You'll develop technical expertise and consulting skills in a culture built on continuous learning, mentorship, and coaching. High-performing interns have a clear pathway into IBM's Associate Program, launching careers at one of the world's most innovative technology and consulting companies.

About The Team

In this role, you will join IBM's US Federal team to deliver secure, mission-critical technology solutions for government agencies. You'll work with federal, state, and local clients while developing specialized expertise in government compliance and security standards. This role offers unique career growth in a high-demand sector where your contributions directly impact public services and government missions.

Your Role And Responsibilities

During your co-op experience, you can enhance your knowledge and gain professional experience by working on client projects. This role provides an exceptional opportunity to build a compelling portfolio, acquire new skills, gain insights into diverse industries, and embrace novel challenges for your future career.

At IBM, we prioritize continuous learning, skill development, and personal growth within a culture of coaching and mentorship. As a co-op, you'll experience this culture and have the opportunity to advance to our associate program based on results and performance.

Work Experiences You Could Be Exposed To

Mentored Analytical Support: Receive mentorship from diverse professionals in science engineering and consulting applying analytical rigor and statistical methods to predict behaviors.Data Integrations: Develop skills in writing efficient and reusable programs to cleanse integrate and model data. Evaluate model results contributing to data-driven insights.Effective Communication: Assist in conveying analytical results to both technical and non-technical audiences, refining your ability to communicate complex findings.Tech-Driven Data Transformation: Utilize program languages like Python to build data pipelines, extracting and transforming data from repositories to consumers. Gain exposure to cloud platforms, ETL tools, and data integration, expanding your tech toolkit.

The primary internship program dates are May 24, 2027 and end May 26, 2028. This role requires candidates to work in University Park, PA.

Candidates must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Federal security clearance while in IBM Consulting-Federal.

To give yourself the best opportunity for success, we advise applying only to roles that align with your skills and experience, rather than applying broadly across all entry-level positions. You’ll receive a status update email for each application, so be sure to check your IBM Careers account regularly — it’s the best way to get a centralized view of which roles you have active applications against.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Currently pursuing a quantitative degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, IST, or a related field.Strong Interpersonal skills that enhance collaboration and relationship building, while also managing dynamic workloads in an agile environment.Have initiative and passion to actively seek new knowledge and improve skills while embracing a growth mindset to assimilate diverse viewpoints.Demonstrate leadership experience and ability to communicate effectively through active listening; while also be willing to adapt and have a readiness to take ownership of tasks and challenges.Familiarity with one or more scripting languages (Python preferred), or a proven computer science foundation.Ability to work in-office, on-site in University Park, PA during the academic year.Ability to work up to 20 hours per week when classes are in session (e.g., fall and spring semesters) and availability to potentially work up to 40 hours per week during academic breaks (e.g., summer).

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Demonstrate familiarity or interest in statistical analysis or data mining through previous internships, personal/academic projects, hackathons, and/or publications.General familiarity with databases, data-engineering tools (SQL, spark) and cloud platforms (e.g., IBM Cloud, Azure, AWS). Experience with NLP/LLM/GenAI is a plus.Experience using machine-learning/data science libraries in python (scikit-learn, SciPy, pandas, PyTorch) is a plus.

About the Opportunity:
 
 We are seeking an experienced AI & Data Engineer – Manufacturing Quality to help transform manufacturing and quality data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, AI agents, and automated workflows. In this role, you will combine data engineering, artificial intelligence, and manufacturing expertise to identify quality trends, uncover root causes, improve operational performance, and support faster, data-driven decision-making.


 You will work closely with cross-functional teams to develop innovative, scalable digital solutions that enhance quality management and drive continuous improvement in a manufacturing environment.


 

 
 
   What You'll Do:
 
 
  
   Analyze large manufacturing and quality datasets to identify defect trends, correlations, anomalies, and root causes.


  
   Develop interactive dashboards, automated reports, and analytics solutions using Python, SQL, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric.


  
   Design, develop, and deploy AI agents to analyze quality data, answer technical questions, generate reports, and support engineering decisions.


  
   Integrate AI solutions with manufacturing databases, quality management systems, and enterprise data sources.


  
   Automate quality monitoring, defect analysis, root-cause investigations, and early-warning detection.


  
   Apply machine learning, statistical methods, and predictive analytics to identify patterns and improvement opportunities.


  
   Collaborate with Quality, Production, Engineering, and IT teams to translate business challenges into practical AI and data solutions.


  
   Validate AI-generated insights to ensure accuracy, reliability, and traceability.


  
   Develop reusable AI agents and analytics tools that can be scaled across manufacturing operations.


 
 

 
 What We're Looking For:


 
  
   Experience in data engineering, data analytics, AI development, or a related technical field, preferably within a manufacturing environment.


  
   Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience in Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric.


  
   Hands-on experience developing AI agents, automated workflows, or AI-powered applications.


  
   Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and API integrations.


  
   Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI, or similar AI development platforms is a plus.


  
   Knowledge of machine learning, statistical analysis, anomaly detection, and data visualization.


  
   Understanding of manufacturing processes, quality management systems, and continuous improvement methodologies.


  
   Familiarity with quality tools and methodologies such as Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Pareto analysis, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and quality KPIs.


  
   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business and engineering insights.

Data Engineer II



Description



Textron is a renowned global multi-industry company with a diverse portfolio spanning aerospace and defense, specialized vehicles, turf care, and fuel systems. Our brand lineup includes leading names like Bell, Cessna, Beechcraft, E-Z-GO, Lycoming Engines and many others. With a strong worldwide presence and a workforce of 34,000 individuals across 25 countries, we prioritize attracting top talent.



Job Summary:



As a Data Engineer II, you will play a key role in architecting, developing, and optimizing robust data infrastructure that empowers the organization’s data-driven initiatives. You will leverage your experience to lead complex data engineering projects, mentor junior team members, and drive continuous improvement of our data systems. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality, well-governed data assets that support strategic decision-making.



Job Responsibilities:




Design, architect, and maintain scalable and resilient data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and delivery across multiple systems and platforms.



Optimize existing data workflows for performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.



Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze data needs, and translate business problems into effective data engineering solutions.



Develop, implement, and enhance data validation, quality, and testing frameworks to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency.



Oversee the deployment and maintenance of data integration solutions, including ETL/ELT processes, real-time streaming, and batch processing.



Contribute to the design and implementation of data models, storage solutions, and metadata management strategies.



Ensure that all data systems comply with industry best practices, security guidelines, and regulatory standards.



Mentor and provide technical guidance to Data Engineer I team members; promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team.



Troubleshoot complex data issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.



Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and trends in data engineering, recommending and adopting new approaches as appropriate.



Recommend ways to improve data reliability, efficiency and quality.



Maintain proper version control for Engineering objects in DevOps environments.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.



3 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles.

jobs_results.description:
Summary

Play a role in bringing Apple technology to the world. We are looking for a hardworking, dedicated, and results-oriented Synthetic Data Engineer. You would join a team using simulation to generate synthetic data. Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something - you'll add something.

Description

As a Simulation Synthetic Data Engineer, you will help develop next-generation simulation technology powering a broad range of AI/ML efforts at Apple. You will work on highly ambitious projects that transform ideas into production tools and datasets used across the organization to develop new Apple products.

We're looking for an engineer who is both practical and inventive-comfortable extending existing simulation frameworks, experimenting with new approaches, and iterating quickly from prototype to high-quality implementation. You will collaborate closely with engineers, technical artists, animators, and research teams to deliver scalable pipelines and compelling synthetic data. Your work will directly influence dataset quality and model performance across multiple product areas.

Responsibilities

Build, enhance, and operate tools and pipelines for scenario creation, simulation execution, and generation of annotated 3D and multi-modal synthetic datasets.

 Design and implement prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and production systems that expand the capabilities of our simulation stack.

 Deliver high-quality, validated datasets to internal customers-leveraging procedural systems, generative models, scene variation tools, and diverse data sources.

 Partner with engineers, animators, and technical artists to transform creative intent into efficient, scalable pipelines for generating, varying, organizing, and validating scenarios.

 Develop tools, APIs, and reusable components that allow other teams to easily generate, manage, and automate simulation workflows.

 Stay current with advances in simulation, rendering, generative models, VLMs, and synthetic data in academia, industry, and at Apple; introduce new approaches where valuable.

Minimum Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Strong programming skills in Python, with solid software engineering fundamentals.

 Experience with 3D graphics or game engines, including topics such as rendering, animation, scene graphs, or content pipelines.

 Familiarity with machine learning workflows, especially perception tasks, generative models, or VLMs.

 Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional partners including engineers, artists, and researchers; strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Programming experience in C++

Experience with real-time simulation engines (Unreal, Unity, Godot, Omniverse, custom engines).

 Familiarity with USD, MaterialX, or other modern 3D content standards.

 Experience with real-time and offline rendering, ray tracing, lighting, or shading.

 Knowledge of physics simulation, sensor simulation, or physically-based modeling.

 Experience with industrial/commercial simulation tools or large-scale data pipelines.

Peraton Overview
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


Responsibilities
Peraton is seeking a Junior Data Engineer with ETL development and geospatial data experience to support the data engineering workstream on a federal data migration program. You will develop and deploy ETL pipelines, execute data ingestion workflows, and support spatial data validation activities within a cloud data Lakehouse environment. This is a fully remote position.


 


The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.


 


Work Location: Remote


 


Day to Day Responsibilities:



 Develop, test, and deploy ETL pipelines using Databricks Delta Live Tables within a cloud data lakehouse staging environment.
 Execute range data aggregation and normalization activities, collecting data from multiple authoritative source systems and normalizing spatial formats and coordinate reference systems.
 Implement source-to-target transformation logic within ETL pipelines, applying field-level mapping rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic
 Execute prototype data ingestion workflows using representative taxa, evaluating results against completeness, accuracy, consistency, and spatial integrity quality criteria.
 Document prototype ingestion results, defects, and remediation actions
 Produce the Prototype Ingest Results Report, documenting ingestion outcomes, data quality findings, defect severity classifications, and remediation actions for each representative taxa batch.
 Log all data quality defects with severity classifications and remediation tracking
 Maintain all ETL pipeline code in a version-controlled repository with mandatory peer review documentation.
 Support spatial data validation activities in coordination with GIS Engineers.
 Support interoperability testing by providing test datasets, pipeline execution support, and data validation assistance.

 Bachelor’s degree and 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 2 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent and 4 years of professional experience.
